description: This file implements a React component that provides an Ace Editor wrapper, supporting multiple languages and exposing an EditorHandle interface for programmatic control. It manages editor configuration, event handling, and integration with external components.

classes.name: AceEditorProvider
classes.description: A React component that wraps the Ace Editor, providing language-specific editors, event handling, and programmatic control via an exposed handle.

methods.name: getEditorComponent
methods.description: Maps editor language to corresponding Ace editor component.

methods.name: toAceAnnotation
methods.description: Converts generic editor annotations to Ace-specific annotation format.

methods.name: createAceEditorHandle
methods.description: Creates an object implementing EditorHandle interface for controlling the Ace editor instance.

methods.name: toAceKeyword
methods.description: Converts generic EditorKeyword to AceCompleterKeyword format.
